about: Starting preset for a village or hamlet: houses, a road or two, fences and gardens. It names no one kind of wall, roof, ground or climate more than another. Data only: code never names a place type. new-settings copies the allowed_off entries that fit into the settings as "off" entries.

allowed_off.reason: inside the buildings: dry, nothing grows (a flagstone floor, floor.stone, may be a patio or a step outdoors, so it is not switched off)

notes: walls of stone, brick, plaster or timber under roofs of tile, slate, shingle or thatch; roads paved or unpaved; the person's words choose the materials, the climate and the look
source: the plugin 1.4.0 design: a first try, judge by looking
